correctness.rationale: The eight positive configuration weights satisfy every generator stationarity equation as exact bivariate polynomial identities, and normalize to two times an explicitly positive denominator. A standalone checker verifies the polynomial identities and 20 separately solved rational linear systems.

value.rationale: The smallest chain allowing a genuine interior Langmuir exchange and two directed hops admits a complete, two-parameter classification of all pair-correlation signs. The proven opposing exchange responses show that strengthened spatial mean polarization does not imply stronger spatial fluctuations, motivating finite-size transport diagnostics. This is a natural exhaustive finite-system statement rather than an arbitrary computed parameter slice or numerical table.
